description: Redirect chain credential-leak check — Walks a supplied HTTP redirect chain (up to 25 hops of status + Location) for an agent or HTTP client author and reports, per hop, which of the request's header names (Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization, API-key-like, Referer) are stripped or still forwarded, the method after the hop (301/302 POST to GET, 303, 307/308), whether the hop crosses origin, scheme, or registrable domain, an http

clientStripsOnCrossOrigin.description: Header names your client deletes on an origin change. Default: ["authorization"], the Fetch Standard rule.

location.description: Location header value; relative references resolve against the previous URL.

publicSuffixes.description: Extra public suffixes for registrable-domain decisions.

requestHeaderNames.description: Names of headers on the initial request. Never send values.

name: redirect-credential-check
